card.summary: No clear public storage cap found. Platform is free SaaS on S3; documented pain point is a '1GB per day' quota on modelState (compute artifacts), not on file...

free_tier.stated: No clear public storage cap found. Platform is free SaaS on S3; documented pain point is a '1GB per day' quota on modelState (compute artifacts), not on file storage.

per_object_cap.notes: The upload page states that Synapse can store files of all types within a project and gives no per-file size limit.

retention.stated: No retention period is stated on the upload page; files must be stored within a project.
retention.notes: The upload page states no retention period; files must be stored within a project.

egress.terms: Anonymous users cannot create projects in Synapse, upload or download data, add wiki content, or comment in a discussion forums.

record.tooling: Python/Java/R clients (`synapseclient`), REST API, and a built-in Docker registry. Also supports custom storage locations (your own S3/GCS). Which makes it a metadata layer over someone else's bucket rather than storage itself.
record.chaining: Synapse provides physical storage for files using Amazon S3, however, you can configure your own custom storage locations as well.
record.limits_note: per-object-cap: none documented for plain files; 1 GB/day on modelState. Retention: indefinite for public content. Gate: upload requires 'certified user' status (a quiz), so no anonymous write path exists.

identity_cost.detail: Certified users have access to full Synapse functionality, including the ability to upload files and tables as well as create folders.

record.reliability_note: Certification gate plus no published quota means capacity is discretionary; large uploads are known to be throttled/queued without a documented ceiling. Treat quota as unverified.
